You are reviewing a C LVGL app at /data/dm/vendor/allwinnertech/apps/luncher_dm/ (openvela/NuttX RTOS). Goal: find SMALL, SAFE, HIGH-VALUE code fixes that improve stability/quality for a competition submission. Do NOT propose speculative rewrites or large refactors. Only concrete, verifiable issues.

Review these files ONLY (ignore pet_cat_*.c, aibg.c, deskmate_icons.c - generated):
- luncher_dm.c (app entry, boot, brightness, lifecycle)
- deskmate_ui.c / deskmate_ui.h (shared builders, show_subpage/close_subpage, dm_net_status_refresh, music core dm_sound_*, dm_kb_* keyboard helpers, dm_tone_worker)
- ui/ui_home.c (home + lockscreen/standby)
- ui/ui_wifi.c, ui/ui_bt.c (WiFi/BT subpages)
- ui/ui_pet.c, pet_core.c, pet_view.c, dm_pet.c (electronic pet)
- dm_als.c (ambient light sensor)

Look specifically for:
1. LVGL object lifecycle: objects created but never deleted (leaks on repeated page enter/exit), dangling pointers after lv_obj_del, use-after-free, missing lv_obj_is_valid checks.
2. Timer/animation leaks: lv_timer_create without delete, lv_anim created repeatedly.
3. Event callback / overlay pitfalls: overlay not closed, callback referencing freed object.
4. Null deref on unchecked lv_* / malloc returns.
5. Buffer overflow in string formatting into fixed buffers.
6. Concurrency: UI thread vs dm_tone_worker, stale globals.
7. Dead code / unused functions / commented-out blocks worth removing for code quality.
8. Magic numbers / duplicated constants that hurt maintainability (only if trivially fixable).

For EACH finding report: `file:line` — one-line problem — why it matters — the minimal fix (1-3 lines). Rank by (severity × tiny-diff/safety). Mark items ALREADY GUARDED to avoid false positives. Be precise with line numbers. Return only the findings list, grouped by file, no preamble.
